# Vendor Software License and Service Agreement 2026

## Article I: Definitions
1.1 "Vendor" means CloudTech Solutions.
1.2 "Client" means Global Enterprises.

## Article II: Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and KPIs
2.1 System Uptime
The Vendor guarantees that the core platform shall maintain an uptime of at least 99.9% measured monthly (KPI-1). If the uptime falls below 99.9%, the Vendor shall pay a penalty of $5,000 per month of violation.

2.2 Support Response Time
The Vendor must respond to critical severity (P1) tickets within 1 hour (KPI-2). Failure to meet this response time on more than 2 occasions in a month incurs a $1,000 penalty per violation thereafter.

2.3 Feature Delivery
The Vendor commits to delivering minor updates bi-weekly. A minimum of 2 updates per month is required (KPI-3). Missing this target reduces the monthly subscription fee by 10%.

## Article III: Termination
3.1 Either party may terminate if there is a material breach of the SLAs persisting for three consecutive months.
